stem.text: Which feature of cellulose molecules contributes to the function of plant cell walls?

A.text: Adjacent cellulose molecules are linked by glycosidic bonds.

B.text: Branched chains of $\beta$-glucose molecules are linked by hydrogen bonds.

C.text: Molecules of $\alpha$-glucose are linked by 1-6 glycosidic bonds.

D.text: Unbranched chains of $\beta$-glucose are linked by hydrogen bonds.
